parsed.rationale: Three types in the same `Playlist` package — `Announcement` (in `_Plant_Announcement.swift:19`), `Breakpoint` (in `PlaylistEntry.swift:57`), and `Talkset` (in `PlaylistEntry.swift:96`) — all expose an identical initializer signature `init(id:hour:chronOrderID:timeCreated:)`, flagged as `function-duplicates-exact`. Because all three share the same parameter labels and live in the same package, the body is almost certainly identical. The idiomatic Swift fix is to introduce (or extend an existing) `PlaylistEntry` protocol with a default implementation of this initializer in a protocol extension, eliminating the per-type boilerplate. None of the records carry `is_test`, `is_codegen`, `is_mock`, or `is_sample_app` flags, so there is no reason to treat this as intentional duplication.
